$comment: **The blur is on the game, not on VOID's chrome.** `design/quiet-cell-system.md` §1 rules blur out of the menu's own surfaces and `screen/BlurBackdrop.java` is off behind VOID's panel for exactly that reason; nothing here changes that. This mod blurs the *world* behind Minecraft's own screens — the inventory, chests, the pause menu — which is a game-visual preference Lunar and Badlion both ship, and it is off by default.
label: Menu blur
on_description: the world is blurred behind menus
description: Blurs the world behind inventories, chests and the pause menu.
settings_description: Settings for the Menu blur gameplay mod. Runs the backdrop blur VOID already carries — a quarter-resolution copy of the frame through a separable Gaussian — under Minecraft's own screens. Chat and VOID's own menu are not blurred. Costs a few frames a second while a screen is open and nothing otherwise.

blur_radius.description: How soft the blur is, in passes of the Gaussian. 1 is a light softening; 10 is unrecognisable.

blur_fade.description: Whether the blur eases in over a fifth of a second as the screen opens, rather than snapping on.

menu_dim.description: How much of vanilla's dark wash is kept over the blur, as a fraction of vanilla's own. 1 is vanilla's darkness on top of the blur; 0 is the blur alone.
